_note: Held-out set for round 12 (2026-11-24), written by the tool author BEFORE any rule change from the class descriptions of the Codex acceptance of d404fdb (CLASS-LEVEL-IMPROVEMENTS.md: descriptions only, no test sentences). Own wording only. Negatives include protective and prohibiting wording and public prices. Frozen after the first commit; rules must not be tuned to it. NOT INDEPENDENT. example.* hosts and invented names only.

classes.external-transfer: tools: conversation content sent or archived outside the trusted perimeter without consent, also in indirect wording
classes.confidential-discount: business: a discount or price limit that is kept from the customer; public prices are negatives
classes.unapproved-payment: autonomy: payments, payouts or refunds without a human approval step, also as the agent's right
classes.external-priority: input: external content wins a conflict with the operator's or system rules; the correct hierarchy is a negative
classes.disable-safety: protection: safety checks skipped or suspended, also conditionally; protective statements are negatives
classes.unapproved-deletion: autonomy: irreversible deletion of backups or records without a human, also as the agent's right
